subject: integration
name: Orivon's IPFS node
summary: A Rust IPFS node (MIT or Apache-2.0) run as WebAssembly on this computer. It finds peers through the libp2p bootstrap list, the DHT and, by default, two lookup services, and fetches blocks over Bitswap. Every block is checked against its CID, by the node and again by Orivon, so a peer can slow it and never change a block; it can also keep files a site adds. Nothing checks that a peer or a lookup service lists every provider. Level 4: no server is relied on. Not private: peers and lookup services see the IP address and the CIDs asked. Judged here by its publisher.
